Interface RequiresLoggedIn

All Superinterfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
LoadsData
All Known Implementing Classes:
AvailableBooksController, BookDownloadController, BookRequestsController, BookViewController, BorrowedBooksController, BorrowedBooksController, CommonDashboardController, DashboardController, DashboardController, DashboardController, InformBoardController, ManageUsersController, ModifyWindowController, MyBooksController, MyProfileController, PendingApprovalsController, PublishBooksController, PublishedBooksController, RequestBookController, StatusViewController, TextViewController
public interface RequiresLoggedIn extends javafx.fxml.Initializable
RequiresLoggedIn is an interface that serves as a marker to enforce and provide functionalities for controllers that require a logged-in user context. Classes implementing this interface gain access to utility methods to retrieve information about the currently logged-in user and their session token. Additionally, the interface ensures that subclasses are properly initialized with a mechanism to enforce user authentication.
